sonnet.problem: The question gives away its own answer. It says the LORD 'names one more group' and then asks whether 'those who trust in Pharaoh' will be punished too, so True is the only sensible pick. Card 7 also left that group out of the verse, so there is nothing for the baker to reason from.
sonnet.rule: A choice card's question never holds its own answer, or a form of it, like "rock badgers" for "in the rocks." Ask something else.

sonnet.problem: The card says 'Israel, His servant Jacob', which treats Israel and Jacob as one person. Jeremiah 46:27 only places 'O Jacob My servant' and 'O Israel' side by side. No verse says outright that the two names mean the same person, and no verse is given.
sonnet.rule: He says two names mean the same person only when a verse says so outright, and he gives that verse.

sonnet.problem: The question says the warriors 'tell each other to get up'. Jeremiah 46:16 says only 'They say, "Get up!..."' and does not say who they are speaking to. The card names the person being addressed.
sonnet.rule: Leave open what the text leaves open: who is being spoken to, why, or how two things connect.
